ISRO SDSC SHAR Various Posts Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC SHAR) has released the Admit Card for the post of Scientist/Engineer, Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Technician, Draughtsman, Nurse, Fireman, Cook, and Driver. This recruitment has been issued for 141 posts. Online applying process for ISRO SDSC SHAR Various Posts Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 16 October 2025 to 21 November 2025. The Examination is going to conducted on 04 September 2026. Candidates must download their ISRO SDSC SHAR Various Posts Admit Card 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 16 October 2025
  • Last Date : 21 November 2025 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 14 November 2025
  • Exam Date : 04 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 01 September 2026

Application Fee

  • For Scientist / TA / Library Assistant / Nurse
  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH, ESM : Rs. 750/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 750/-
  • For All Other Vacancies
  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH, ESM : Rs. 500/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 500/-
  • Fees Refunded Appearing after Exam
  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 400/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
